# benchmark/benchmarkmapmanager2/esp32/CMakeLists.txt -- ESP-IDF project that
# runs stage 2 of benchmarkmapmanager2 ON the ESP32: the same replay the fleet
# runs, with the workload (generated by stage 1 for this board) compiled into
# flash. No WiFi, no lwIP, no filesystem, no datapack.
#
# The generated workload is passed in the environment, never checked in:
#   CC_WORKLOAD_CPP=/path/workload-esp32.cpp idf.py -B <out-of-tree> build
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)
project(benchmark-mapmanager2-esp32)
